messages:
Priya D.: Heads-up — I'm going to bring up the new int4-quant variant for the q6b family for smoke/eval runs today. Need a tightly deduped promptset (no leaking holdouts) for parity/regression checks before we flip traffic. Can we pause new ingest for a 30m window and run a fast fuzzy-dedupe + long-context preservation? cc @Maya C., @Ethan W.

curation-bot: ingest pause scheduled by curation-bot — window=30m (starts now). Alerts will resume after window.

Maya C.: OK. Quick Qs: what fuzzy threshold do you want? I usually run simhash + token-span normalization, threshold ~0.84 for short prompts, tighter for long ones. Also: keep multi-turn sequences intact or collapse them to single-turn fingerprints?

Priya D.: Use 0.86 for single-turn prompts, 0.80 for multi-turn (we want to avoid dropping paraphrase variants in dialog flows). Keep multi-turn intact if turn-count >=3; otherwise fingerprint collapsed. Also preserve examples with context_len >=512 regardless of score (edge-case whitelist).

Ethan W.: Labeling capacity note: we can spare 2 labelers for a 2hr gold-annotation sprint, or 1 labeler for 4hrs. For a 1k golden sample I recommend 2 labelers to speed consensus. Also need clear pass/fail rubric for hallucination/regression.

Anna: I can do the 2hr sprint if you provide the rubric. For consensus: majority wins, but if 2-way tie escalate to senior reviewer. Do we want to mark \"intent-aligned\" vs \"safe-halluc\" separate flags?

Olga P.: Add long-context stress cases to the golden: 512-2k token summaries, code-only prompts, and mixed-lingual prompts. Those are the ones that regressed on q4b previously.

Priya D.: Yes to both. Rubric draft (will refine):
- correct/incorrect for factual tasks
- hallucination severity: none / minor (mismatch detail) / major (fabrication)
- format correctness (for code/structure tasks)
- overall accept/reject

I'll post the seed set link after I trim it.

Maya C.: I'll run dedupe with these params:
```
--short-thresh 0.86
--multi-turn-thresh 0.80
--whitelist-len 512
--keep-turns-if-turncount 3
--method simhash+spannorm
```
Expect ~12-15k candidates -> downsample to 3k -> produce golden-1k sample + 2k holdout. I'll push artifacts to /mnt/curation/priya/1748500123/

Ethan W.: I'll create a label task and assign Anna + Ben (senior). Ben will resolve escalations. ETA to have 1k annotated: 6 hours after we publish the CSV.

Anna: Ack. Prefer CSV with columns: id, prompt, metadata.token_len, note. Anything else?

Priya D.: Add fields: model_ref (q6b-int4-smoke), origin (sampling-policy), withheld_holdout boolean. I'll upload the seed and the rubric here: https://redwood.internal/curation/seed/1748500123

curation-bot: file uploaded: /mnt/curation/priya/1748500123/deduped-sample-3k.csv (sha256: abcdef...)

Maya C.: Ran dedupe, pushed files:
- /mnt/curation/priya/1748500123/deduped-3k.csv
- /mnt/curation/priya/1748500123/golden-1k.csv
Pipeline stats: orig=12,487 -> deduped=3,012 -> holdout=2,012 -> golden=1,000

Ethan W.: Label task created: task_id LBL-17485. Assigned Anna + Ben. ETA: 6h for full 1k pass. Will post progress updates.

Priya D.: Great — once golden is back we'll run the parity eval and compare token-level loss + top-k response diffs vs baseline q6b-fp16. If regressions >3% on any critical metric we pause rollout.

Olga P.: Can we also run a quick contrast-run with kv-cache disabled to catch cache-sensitive regressions? Those were sneaky before.

Maya C.: Sure — I'll include cache-off subset (200 examples) in the eval matrix.

Ethan W.: Noted. I'll wire the evaluation pipeline to send a regression alert to #eng-ml if fail criteria hit.

Priya D.: Thanks team. Kicking bring-up at 14:30 PT after the label sprint. If anything blocks, ping here. :rocket:
